POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.

4. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

7. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.

8. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.

11. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

12. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Limits, fits and tolerance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain ISO Thread forms and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Braking system and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

5. A — CPU

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
